use_when: Use type web at the top of every page of the guest website, with the current section as the first, darker link.
Use type app at the top of each app screen below the status bar: back on the left, the screen name in the centre, one text action on the right when the screen has one, such as "Save" or "Mark read".
Use type backoffice above the content of each back office page, next to the Sidebar, with the page name and search.
Keep the app title short (one or two words) so it stays centred and never truncates.
Turn ShowAvatar off for signed-out guests on web; the Book now button stays.
Hide the back chevron (ShowBack off) only on the top-level tabs of the app, such as Explore or Trips.

dont_use_when.when: More than once on a page, or inside a card or a modal.
To hold page actions such as "Export" or "Add rate": put them in the page content, under the title.
With more than three nav links on web: move the rest into the Help page or the footer.

variant_intent.web: at the top of every page of the guest website, with the current section as the first, darker link.
variant_intent.app: at the top of each app screen below the status bar: back on the left, the screen name in the centre, one text action on the right when the screen has one, such as "Save" or "Mark read".
variant_intent.backoffice: above the content of each back office page, next to the Sidebar, with the page name and search.

a11y.fact: The root is a native <header> element.
The web nav links sit in a <nav> landmark named "Main" (aria-label).
The first web link, the current section, carries aria-current="page".
The app back control is a native <button type="button"> named "Back" (aria-label); its chevron icon is hidden from assistive technology (aria-hidden).
The back chevron svg is aria-hidden and not focusable.
The app title is rendered as an <h1>.
The app action is a native <button type="button"> whose accessible name is its text.
The backoffice page title is rendered as an <h1>.
The back and action buttons show a focus-visible outline in the focus border colour.
